purpose: Replay verification for the Technology Sector Engine — must reproduce identical composites, verdicts, pillars, overrides, evidence, and resolved calibration version.
note: Replay uses the same golden provider inputs twice; outputs must be byte-identical. The resolved calibration profile version (including any calibrated band-table overrides) is part of the replay identity (D15 §6a.4): identical inputs + identical resolved calibration version -> identical composite + verdict.
